item.title: [Message Center] MC1551151 Microsoft Entra ID: Risk-based anti-bot verification (CAPTCHA) for SMS and voice multi-factor authentication
item.description:

item.description:

Graph · List service principals holding NetworkAccess.ReadWrite.All and CopilotCostManagement.Read.All and confirm the reach is intended.

item.title: [Due in 3 days] Enterprise Agreement billing roles: new assignments must use work or school accounts from 16 November, a month later than Microsoft first wrote
item.description:
Enterprise Agreement roles are assigned outside Entra roles and Azure RBAC. Microsoft's page says an Enterprise administrator can 'Create new subscriptions under active enrollment accounts' and an Account owner can 'Manage subscription role assignments'. A personal Microsoft account holding one of them signs in outside the tenant's Conditional Access and sign-in logs (inferred). The cut-off for new assignments moved by a month; existing assignments are not touched yet.

Azure · deadline 2026-11-16 · List the Enterprise Agreement billing role assignments in Cost Management + Billing and move every personal Microsoft account to a work or school account before 16 November 2026, starting with Enterprise administrators and Account owners.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Entra adds a risk-based CAPTCHA before some SMS and voice MFA codes and calls from mid-November; restrictive firewalls can stop the prompt loading
item.description:
A sign-in that cannot load the CAPTCHA fails MFA, so help-desk tickets and sign-in failures from locked-down networks will rise; telephony MFA fraud (toll fraud, automated pumping) is the threat it targets.

Entra · Brief the help desk, check that proxies and web filters let the Entra verification resources load during sign-in, and keep moving users from SMS and voice to passkeys.

item.title: [New] SharePoint temporary-authentication (tempauth) URLs retire on 1 April 2027; Power Apps and flows that hand out pre-authenticated SharePoint links break
item.description:
Pre-authenticated SharePoint URLs are bearer links: anyone holding one downloads the file without signing in. Their retirement closes an exfiltration path; custom connectors that depend on them will fail.

Power Platform · Inventory custom Power Platform controls, actions and connectors that return or consume SharePoint tempauth URLs and move them to Entra ID tokens before 1 April 2027.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Since the October 2026 updates, domain controllers require LDAP Kerberos tickets to match the LDAP SPN; NetApp SMB shares with LDAP session security 'none' can fail
item.description:
A DC hardening that blocks tickets issued for other services from authenticating to LDAP; rolling it back to restore storage access reopens the hole it closes.

Windows Server · Find NetApp and Azure NetApp Files AD connections with LDAP session security 'none' and move them to sign or seal; follow KB5134907 instead of holding back DC updates.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 5 days] Workforce Insights endpoint in MODS retires 18 November; custom non-public attributes such as job level move to the Microsoft 365 profile endpoint and become visible to Copilot experiences
item.description:
Non-public HR attributes such as job level that were scoped to one Frontier agent become available to Copilot experiences generally once they move to the profile endpoint, which is a data-exposure decision for privacy and governance, not a plumbing change.

Copilot · deadline 2026-11-18 · If you upload custom attributes to the Workforce Insights endpoint, list them, agree an access policy with privacy stakeholders, then re-select the Microsoft 365 profile endpoint before 18 November.

item.title: [Due in 3 days] Teams consolidates GitHub Notifications and GitHub Copilot into one GitHub app; the legacy app is deprecated by 16 November 2026
item.description:
A new third-party app identity replaces the old one, so an app permission policy that allowed the legacy GitHub app does not automatically cover the new one, and its consent must be reviewed like any new app.

Teams · deadline 2026-11-16 · Check the Teams app permission policies and the Entra consent granted to the new GitHub app before 16 November, and remove the legacy app from allow lists afterwards.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 4 days] Viva Glint: the Service Admin role gets access to every report attribute from 17 November 2026
item.description:
A role that today sees a restricted set of survey attributes will see all of them, so anyone holding Service Admin gains access to employee survey data they could not read before.

Viva · deadline 2026-11-17 · List who holds the Viva Glint Service Admin role before 17 November and move people who only need reports to a narrower role.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 2 days] Exchange Online stops returning selected properties from Get-Mailbox -Migration on 15 November and blocks setting them through New-Mailbox -Migration on 15 December
item.description:
Mailbox-migration and onboarding scripts that read these properties will get empty values without an error, so a provisioning or audit job can silently produce wrong output.

Exchange Online · deadline 2026-11-15 · Search automation, runbooks and third-party migration tools for Get-Mailbox -Migration and New-Mailbox -Migration before 15 November, compare the properties they read with Microsoft's list, and test the scripts against a tenant where the change has landed.

item.title: [Due in 2 days] App Governance permissions change for three Entra roles as Defender XDR Unified RBAC takes over
item.description:
Two compliance roles silently lose an app-governance capability and one security role gains it: an app-governance policy nobody can edit, or one an unexpected role can now edit, is a control gap either way.

Defender XDR · deadline 2026-11-15 · Before mid-November, list who reaches App Governance through Compliance Administrator, Compliance Data Administrator or Cloud App Security Administrator, review custom Defender XDR Unified RBAC roles for Defender for Cloud Apps, and reassign affected people to a supported Entra role or a custom Unified RBAC role on least privilege.

item.title: [New] Defender for Office 365 threat policies switch multi-condition recipient targeting from AND to OR; an existing policy converts when an admin next edits it, and its scope can widen
item.description:
A policy written as 'users in group X AND in domain Y' becomes 'X OR Y' on its next edit, so an anti-phishing, Safe Links or Safe Attachments policy meant for a narrow population can silently start applying to a whole domain, and a stricter policy can override the one the SOC expects for those mailboxes.
